asteroid.name: Asteroid
asteroid.description: Impassable rock. Blocks line of sight.

planet.name: Planet
planet.description: A world or moon in the system. Impassable. Blocks line of sight.

debris.name: Debris Field
debris.description: Drifting rubble and ring dust. Costs 2 AP to enter. Half cover (-30% damage) from attacks on this side.

nebula.name: Nebula
nebula.description: Ionised gas. Costs 2 AP to enter and blocks line of sight through it.

wall.name: Bulkhead Wall
wall.description: Impassable. Blocks line of sight. Full cover (-50% damage) from attacks on this side.

door.name: Door
door.description: Passable, but blocks line of sight.

crates.name: Cargo Crates
crates.description: Half cover (-30% damage) from attacks on this side; standing in them also cuts damage 30%. Costs 2 AP to enter.

glare.name: Stellar Glare
glare.description: Too close to the sun: searing plasma and blinding light. Impassable, blocks line of sight.
